scope: Existing compact source pool and target fit rows; server-only reads, no sampling or training changes
row_gap_definition: Differences in original source_row_index between consecutive selected rows sharing global_trajectory_id
immediate_successor_definition: Fraction of these within-trajectory row gaps equal to one; measures retention of the original next row, not geometric state coverage
interpretation: Sparse original successor retention and large source terminal costs are observed pool asymmetries. Their interaction with undiscounted IQL and Huber delta one is a diagnostic hypothesis, not established causation or a policy performance claim. Original selected transition pairs retain their adjacent next states.
